port.description: The port of the http server

directory.description: The directory containing the files served by the http server

clientScriptRoute.description: Route from which the script responsible for reloading the page will be served from

websocketRoute.description: The route from which the client script will be notified of reload events

pingIntervalMs.description: The interval between ping messages sent by the server to the client

watch.description: The configuration for the filesystem watcher

directories.description: Directories that will be watched (recursively) for changes

handlers.description: The handlers for the file's changes

pattern.description: The patterne that a file path should match to trigger this handler

command.description: The command that will be launched when this handler is triggered

args.description: The arguments for the command of this handler

events.description: The event types that will trigger this handler
